{{Quote|The Darkwalkers have one of the stolen Gungan artifacts in their possession. Soften up the Darkwalker's defenses in the area by attacking some of them, so that you'll be able to recover the artifact.|Boss Rugor Nass|<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtD" />}}
The '''Darkwalker Bunker''' was an underground facility located a short distance west of the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] used by the [[Darkwalkers]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the bunker to retrieve a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact stolen by the Darkwalkers. Several Darkwalkers and their leader [[Vran Tristen]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Darkwalker Bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Darkwalker Bunker was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
